summary: Full /fullrea binary dissection of ubnt_poll_host.ko (WA AR9342) and uph.ko (XC QCA9558): proved 100% identical .rodata/.data/.bss and only 5 instruction diffs (20B: skb->data 0xc4 vs 0xc8 + GPS GPIO 11 vs 20), mapped /proc/sys/dev/ubnt_poll vs /proc/sys/dev/uph vs /proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0, proved allow_80211=1 + op_mode=0 STA 5-gate & AP 4-gate TDMA poller bypass, decoded SyncFlex/fixed_frame (0=Auto, 1=FF_4ms, 2=FF_8ms, 3=FF_2ms, 4=FF_5ms, 5=FF_10ms), AtpcTarget/atpc, Timing/timing, no_ack_rate/noack_mode/ro, and cataloged UPH-BUG-01..08.

wa_vs_xc_text_instruction_diffs.explanation: CONFIRMED: Loads `skb->data` (`0xc4($s1)` on WA AR9342 vs `0xc8($s1)` on XC QCA9558 due to +4B `struct sk_buff` layout shift).
CONFIRMED: Loads `skb->data` (`0xc4($s0)` on WA vs `0xc8($s0)` on XC) when constructing WMI 0x901f `ht_comm` payload.
CONFIRMED: Loads `skb->data` (`0xc4($s0)` on WA vs `0xc8($s0)` on XC) before `dev_queue_xmit`.
CONFIRMED: Requests GPS reset GPIO pin (`GPIO 11` `0x0b` on WA AR9342 vs `GPIO 20` `0x14` on XC QCA9558).
CONFIRMED: Toggles GPS reset GPIO pin (`GPIO 11` `0x0b` on WA AR9342 vs `GPIO 20` `0x14` on XC QCA9558).

legacy_m5_direct_attach_branch.explanation: CONFIRMED: `/bin/ubntbox` (`ubntconf` radio plugin) only emits `/proc/sys/dev/ubnt_poll/*` when radio capability bit 21 (`0x200000`, offload radio flag) is 0 (legacy M5 `XW`/`XM` with host-side `ubnt_poll.ko`). On `WA`/`XC` (`QCA988x` offload radios), bit 21 is 1 and `ubntbox` routes all TDMA controls to `/sys/module/umac/parameters/*`, `/proc/sys/dev/uph/*`, and `/proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/*`.

allow_80211_and_op_mode_tdma_bypass.subsystem_attribution: proprietary airMAX/LTU module (`ubnt_poll_host.ko` / `uph.ko` + `umac.ko` + `/bin/wpad` + `/bin/ubntbox`) interoperating with `mac80211` (`OpenWrt` 4-address WDS)

ubnt_op_mode.effect: CONFIRMED: When `is_ubnt_ptp == 0`, `ubnt_op_mode == 0` selects `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptmp_ap_bin` and allocates AP target descriptors (`85` peers / `170` TIDs in Flex or `60` peers / `120` TIDs in FF), whereas `ubnt_op_mode == 1` selects `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptmp_sta_bin` (`30` peers / `60` TIDs). When `is_ubnt_ptp == 1`, both load `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin`.

uph_enable_and_veriwave.vap_attach_propagation_offset: `ubnt_poll_host_radio_set_data` (`0x00005824..0x00005890`) -> `ubnt_poll_host_set_ptmp_poll_info` (`0x00007588`: stores `enable` at `uph_dev+0x08` and sends WMI `0x901f` `ht_comm` `msg_type=0x0d` with `msg[0x0c] = enable`)
uph_enable_and_veriwave.ptp_xmit_runtime_toggle: `/proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/ptp_xmit` (`0x00003290..0x00003314`) -> calls `ubnt_poll_host_set_ptp_poll_info` (`0x000074c8`, WMI `0x901f` `msg_type=0x0c`) when `vec[0] != 0` or `ubnt_poll_host_set_ptmp_poll_info(uph_dev, 0)` (`0x00007588`, WMI `0x901f` `msg_type=0x0d` with `enable=0`) when `vec[0] == 0`, halting target TDMA polling live!

sta_5_gate_bypass_architecture.mechanism: CONFIRMED: Step 0 (`0x008b60`) deletes BSSID from `sta_list` (`uph_dev+0x10ec`) if `connected_ap == NULL`; Step 1 (`0x008b80`) only re-inserts BSSID into `sta_list` if the Beacon contains an encrypted Ubiquiti `00:27:22` (`0x002722`) `msg_type=1` IE with `(caps & 3) != 0`.

CONFIRMED: Checks `scan_res->airmax_ie` (`+0x68`) and `wpa_s->conf->allow_80211` (`+0x224`). Setting `allow_80211=1` in `/etc/wpasupplicant_WPA-PSK.conf` prevents `/bin/wpad` from rejecting standard `mac80211` (`OpenWrt`) Beacons with `skip - non-airMAX AP (airmax_ie=disabled)`.

CONFIRMED: Calls `sta_list_find(uph_dev+0x10ec, bssid)` (`0x00a3b0`) and executes `sltu $v0, $zero, $v0` (`0x00a3b8`). Bypassed either via (a) Two-Stage Beacon IE Withdrawal (beacon `00:27:22` IE present during scan, withdrawn before AssocReq), or (b) 1-instruction patch at `.text+0x00a3b8` (`00 02 10 2b` -> `24 02 00 01` `addiu $v0, $zero, 1`, as in `xc_8725_uph_patched.ko`).

CONFIRMED: When `sta_list_find(uph_dev+0x10ec, bssid) == NULL`, calls `ubnt_poll_host_set_ignore_nav(0)` (restoring standard 802.11 CSMA/CA NAV backoff), sends WMI `0x901f` `msg_type = (is_ptp ? 0x0c : 0x0d)` with `mode = 0` (`sw $zero, 0x3c($sp)` / `sb $zero, 0x3c($sp)` at `0x0092d4`/`0x0092ec`) to disable the QCA988x target TDMA poller, logs `'Associating with normal AP'`, and omits the `00:27:22` `msg_type=2` IE.

CONFIRMED: When `sta_list_find == NULL`, `on_assoc_resp_rx` sets `*(u8 *)(uph_dev + 8) = 0` (`enable=0`), logs `'Associated with Normal AP'`, and returns `0` (allow); `on_sta_connect` (`0x0083e4`) leaves `uph_dev->connected_ap` (`+0x10f0`) = `NULL`, preventing the `2000 jiffies` (`20s`) missing-poll watchdog (`ubnt_poll_host_sta_bmiss_ind` at `0x007800`) from firing.

ap_4_gate_bypass_architecture.stock_ap_rejection_path: CONFIRMED: When `uph_dev->mode == 1` (AP), stock `ubnt_poll_host_on_assoc_req_rx` (`0x009594`) rejects any STA whose Association Request lacks a valid encrypted `00:27:22` `msg_type=2` IE (`ubnt_poll_host_proto_check_ie` at `0x00967c`), and `ubnt_poll_host_check_sta` (`0x001860`) drops data frames from unpolled STAs.

xc_8725_uph_ap_patched_ko_5_surgical_pat.effect: Tells `umac.ko` every associated STA is valid without requiring TDMA state.
Skips TDMA scheduler enrollment (`ubnt_poll_host_send_ptmp_netconf` / `add_sta_info`) so the QCA988x target stays in CSMA/CA 4-addr WDS mode.
Accepts standard `mac80211` (`OpenWrt`) Association Requests that lack `00:27:22` vendor IEs.
Allows AP/STA candidate matching regardless of `sta_list` membership.
Suppresses `00:27:22` airMAX IE insertion in AP Beacons/ProbeResps/AssocResps so `OpenWrt` and `airOS 8` (`allow_80211=1`) STAs associate cleanly as standard 802.11ac WDS peers.

vector_10_int_state_map.name: ff_dl_alloc
vector_10_int_state_map.quantizer: Quantized at `0x2f84..0x2ffc` to `{25, 33, 50, 67, 75}`% (subject to `UPH-BUG-03` for inputs `25..32`!). In `init_ptmp_netconf` (`0x0000d764..0x0000d88c`), computes `usable_us = ff_frame_dur - down_dur_gap - up_dur_gap - (ff_cbp_slots * cbp_dur_slot)`, `down_dur = (usable_us * ff_dl_alloc) / 100` (`uph_dev+0xa6`), and `up_dur = usable_us - down_dur` (`uph_dev+0xa8`).

vector_10_int_state_map.name: ff_cbp_slots
vector_10_int_state_map.quantizer: Clamped at `0x3004..0x3034` to `3..10` Contention-Based Polling (CBP) slots.

vector_10_int_state_map.name: gps_sync_mode
vector_10_int_state_map.quantizer: Selects `netconf.flags` `0x4009` (non-GPS FF) vs `0x10009` (GPS Sync bit 0) vs `0x20009` (GPS Sync bit 1) at `0x0000d938..0x0000d980`.

vector_10_int_state_map.name: ff_flex (SyncFlex)
vector_10_int_state_map.radio_entry_offset: u8 radio+0xe0 bit 7 (value 1 or 2) or bit 6 (value 3)
vector_10_int_state_map.uph_dev_offset: u8 uph_dev+0x114 bit 7/6 -> `netconf.flags` (`0x0002` at `0xd9c4` or `0x8000` at `0xd9ec`)
vector_10_int_state_map.quantizer: Enables `SyncFlex` hybrid GPS-synchronized flexible framing on the QCA988x target.

vector_5_int_state_map.name: atpc_def_power_dbm
vector_5_int_state_map.storage: `u8 radio+0xd2` -> `u8 uph_dev+0x108` -> sent to QCA988x target via `ubnt_poll_host_set_ptp_atpc_def_power` (`0x00007494`, WMI `0x901f` `msg_type=0x0c`) or `ubnt_poll_host_set_ptmp_sta_atpc` (`0x0000762c`, `msg_type=0x0d`).

ac_noack_mode.storage: `u8 radio+0xcc` (sets bit 2 `0x04` of `radio+0xc0`). In `ubnt_poll_host_set_ptp_poll_info` (`0x000074c8`), sets bit 15 (`0x8000`) of `uph_dev+0x1e` and sends WMI `0x901f` `msg_type=0x0c` with `mode = (noack ? 3 : 1)`.

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: Deliberate NULL-Write Bomb (`sb $zero, 0($zero)`) & 30-Minute `panic("ubnt-poll-host: #8e511820")` Time-Bomb
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: 1) Every `hook_host_ops` wrapper checks if `hook_cb` (`.bss+0x00`) is NULL and executes `sb $zero, 0($zero)` (`a0 00 00 00`) to crash the kernel with an unaligned/NULL store OOPs. 2) The periodic timer callback at `.text+0x07bd8` checks if `jiffies - *(u32 *)(uph_dev + 0x288)` exceeds `1,800,000` ms (`30` minutes = `0x001b7740`) and calls `panic('ubnt-poll-host: #8e511820')` (`0x07c18`) if `uph_dev+0x288` is not refreshed by proprietary handshake traffic! (`xc_8725_uph_patched.ko` patches `0x07c08` from `14 40 00 06` `bnez $v0, 0x7c24` to `10 00 00 06` `b 0x7c24` to defuse this bomb).

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: Unbounded `sscanf("%s")` 32-Byte Stack Buffer Overflow in `/proc/sys/dev/uph/addradio` & `strcpy` in `radio_add`
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: `ubnt_poll_host_sysctl_addradio` (`0x001c78`) reads up to `100` bytes (`maxlen=100` at `.data+0x00d0`) into `.bss+0x0118`, then calls `sscanf(buf, '%s %d %d %d %d', sp+0x20, ...)` where `sp+0x20..0x3f` is only a 32-byte stack buffer (followed immediately by `$s0`, `$s1`, and `$ra` at `sp+0x40..0x48`), overflowing saved registers if token 1 > 31 bytes.

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: Broken `ff_dl_alloc` Quantizer Branch (`slti $v1, $v1, 0x19` Overwrites Input Register) Jumping `25..32%` to `50%`
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: At `0x002fbc`, `beql $v0, $zero, 0x2ffc` only executes its delay slot `addiu $v1, $zero, 0x32` when `ff_dl_alloc >= 50` (and `< 67`). When `ff_dl_alloc < 50`, `$v1` still holds the raw user input. At `0x002fcc`, `slti $v1, $v1, 0x19` clobbers `$v1` with the boolean `0` (if input in `25..32`) or `1` (if input `< 25`), and at `0x002fe0..0x002fe4` (`movz $v1, $a2, $v0` with `$a2 = 0x32`), any input in `25..32` sets `$v1 = 50` (`0x32`) instead of `25` (`0x19`)!

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: Shared 16-Int `.bss+0x09a8` Vector Clobber (`FMX-DISC-11`) & Unsaved `ro` Rate-Override Readback (`uph_dev+0x15e..0x166`)
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.severity: MEDIUM (Silent Runtime Knob Corruption & Zero Readback)

offsets.shared_bss_vector: .bss+0x09a8..0x09e7 (`int sysctl_vec[16]` shared by all 21 integer sysctls)

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: 1) All 21 integer sysctls under `/proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/` point `ctl_table.data` to the SAME `.bss+0x09a8` array (`maxlen=64` bytes), and `ff_mcast_airtime_limit` (`0x00323c`) reads `sysctl_vec[0]` directly without copying to `uph_dev` unless written last (`FMX-DISC-11`). 2) Writing `/proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/ro` (`0x00276c`) sends WMI `0x901f` `msg_type=0x1e` via `0x00b2d4` but never stores `sysctl_vec[0..8]` into `uph_dev+0x15e..0x166`, so reading `/proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/ro` always returns `0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0`.

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: `atpc` `min_power` / `max_power` Field Inversion Between `/bin/ubntbox` and `ubnt_poll_host_init_ptmp_netconf`
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: In `.rodata` `ptmp_netconf` defaults (`0x0b28`), offset `+100` (`uph_dev+0x100`) is initialized to `30` (`0x1e` max power) and `+101` (`uph_dev+0x101`) to `0` (`min power`), and `atpc` readback (`0x002320..0x00232c`) labels `radio+0xd1` (`vec[2]`) as `min` and `radio+0xd0` (`vec[3]`) as `max`, while `/bin/ubntbox` passes `maxpower` in `vec[2]` and `0` in `vec[3]`.

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: Unnecessary Runtime Lockout on `noack_mode` (`0x002884`) and `daprot` (`0x002d18`) When `radio->uph_dev != NULL`
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.severity: LOW/MEDIUM (Requires VAP Recreate or Direct `ptp_xmit` Workaround)
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: Both `noack_mode` and `daprot` reject writes whenever `radio_entry->uph_dev` (`+0xe4`) is non-NULL (i.e. while `ath0` is up), even though `ubnt_poll_host_set_ptp_poll_info` (`0x0074c8`) and `send_ptmp_netconf` (`0x00dc28`) can update the QCA988x target dynamically at runtime.

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: Suboptimal Default `cms_bias=0` & `voip_bias=0` in All 8 `.rodata` `ptmp_netconf` Profiles (`0x0b28..0x0e67`)
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.severity: MEDIUM (Hidden-Node Retry Suppression & VoIP Dynamic Duration Disabled by Default)
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: All 8 `.rodata` `ptmp_netconf` templates initialize `cms_bias=0` (`dl_per_thresh_nr=100%`, `ul_per_thresh_nr=100%`) and `voip_bias=0`, leaving hidden-node retry suppression and VoIP dynamic slot duration off until `cms_bias=6` and `voip_bias=6` are written to `/proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/`.

hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.title: Suboptimal Default `ff_mcast_airtime_limit=10%` (`/bin/ubntbox` `0x0041ef2c`) & `tx_queue_len=50` Tail-Drop
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.severity: MEDIUM (IPTV Multicast Starvation / Unicast Airtime Bloating)
hidden_bugs_and_suboptimal_constants.root_cause: `/bin/ubntbox` defaults `radio.1.polling_ff_mcast_airtime` to `10%`, while `ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5` (written LAST per `FMX-DISC-11` alongside `DMS=1` / `IGMPv2` fast-leave and `tx_queue_len=256`) eliminates unpolled group-addressed beacon-rate airtime bloat (`Stage 34A/39A/40A/70C`).
